verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac User Guide has a topic titled "Run Windows on your Mac", so the product's own documentation addresses running Windows. Nothing in the pack says this happens in a virtual machine (rather than dual-boot or third-party tools), what Windows versions or apps work, or how well it performs. Missing for 10: evidence of virtual-machine (not dual-boot) execution, detail on setup and supported Windows versions, performance and app-compatibility information, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run a full Windows environment in a virtual machine for apps not natively available
